sections.title: 7.1 Interface criteria
sections.text_preview: The central trading system has relation with three modules that are trading client serve、trading manager system、information releasing module. These modules have contact with CTS using the interface su

sections.title: 7.1.1 Transaction User Interface
sections.text_preview: The Transaction User Interface has to input the instructions. The input instruction is divided into three kinds: buy instruction, sell instruction and query instruction.

sections.title: a) buy instruction
sections.text_preview: This instruction should have five parameters: user ID, stock ID, quantity, respected price, timestamp.

sections.title: b) sell instruction
sections.text_preview: This instruction should have five parameters: user ID, stock ID, quantity, respected price, timestamp.

sections.title: c) query instruction
sections.text_preview:
This instruction can be divided into two kinds: user query instruction and the stock query instruction. The user query instruction should have three

parameters: user ID, query content, some restrict

sections.title: 7.1.2 Information Releasing Module
sections.text_preview: The information releasing module use the interface to find the price of the stocks. The input should has two parameters including the stock name and the restrict parameter.

sections.title: 7.1.3 Trading manager system
sections.text_preview: The trading manager system uses the interface to find the user’s trading instruction. The input should has two parameters including the trading instruction type(buy or sell),and the restrict parameter

sections.title: 7.2 Function Criteria
sections.text_preview: The CTS deals with trading instruction, query instruction and some cancel instruction. The functions are as follows:

sections.title: 1) instruction matching
sections.text_preview: When the client serve get a trading instruction, it will send the instruction to the CTS to trade with other trading instructions. The process of the trading includes the following two main principles

sections.title: 2) rising and falling limit
sections.text_preview: If the trading price is higher(lower) than the rising limit (falling limit), the CTS will reject this trading instruction.

sections.title: 3) return the result
sections.text_preview:
The CTS will return the result to the client serve for any trading instructions than go into the CTS.

The trading states are divided into two kinds: totally finished and the partially finished.

sections.title: 4) outdated instruction
sections.text_preview: If a instruction haven’t finished it’s trading in one day, then it will be removed form the CTS for out of date.
